headline: French PM aims for modest deficit reduction in 2027 with target of 4.9%
description: Le Monde has learned that Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu's draft budget is based on a 'realistic' deficit reduction, without any major reforms. The goal of bringing the deficit under 3% by 2029 now seems even more unlikely.

headline: Natalie Massenet and Erik Torstensson: A fiery romance torn apart by a courtroom battle
description: 'Sewn and torn' (4/5). Love stories and friendships can sometimes end badly, even in the world of fashion. For 16 years, the romance between the founder of luxury e-shop Net-a-Porter and the Swedish golden boy blossomed alongside their financial empire. But in 2025, when Natalie Massenet accused her partner of infidelity and fraud, their glamorous affair turned sordid.

headline: 'It was either exile or prison': An interview with Boris Nadezhdin, Putin opponent who fled to France
description: The veteran Russian politician, 63, tried to challenge Vladimir Putin's regime and its war in Ukraine through legal and electoral means. He failed. Facing the threat of arrest, he decided to leave Russia. His interview with Le Monde is his first since arriving in France.

description: 'My Breasts and Me' (4/5). Once a symbol of objectifying women, plastic surgery now draws more women practitioners. headline: The long fight to return the 'Ségou treasure,' a spoil of colonization
description: The Sufi spiritual leader El Hadj Omar Tall, who counted hundreds of thousands of followers, was a 19th-century scholar and anti-colonialist fighter. France's adoption of a law on the restitution of stolen cultural property could allow his descendants to recover his manuscripts, jewelry, and valuable possessions.
